_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 5% base rate for ±2+ point score moves over 7 days screams coil, and neither brain has produced a confirmed breaker — the analyst's own 8.9% transition accuracy and 19.6% direction accuracy reinforce that statistically honest means waiting for the $65K close or $60K failure to resolve the compression.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst leans UP toward Hope with low conviction but explicitly conditions it on a BTC break above $65K; narrative implies accumulation will resolve upward but does not specify a trigger; consensus judge overrides both with HOLD based on the 95% historical base rate of score stability in this window.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC closes above $65,000 with funding below 0.015% and DXY breaks below 99.50
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60,000 with VIX spiking above 20 and funding turning negative
